_purpose: Rendering rules for UI v3 ego-spoke labels + connections digest. Raw edge direction is NOT safe to gloss with a verb for all relationship types. Read the three rule blocks before wiring labels.
_measured: 342 edges, 109 distinct relationship values, all edges carry exactly {source,target,relationship,rel_class,weight} (no notes; provenance lives in profiles/*.md edge lines).

rule_1_money_is_directional_safe.verdict: Directional gloss OK. Source=donor/spender, target=recipient/beneficiary, consistent across all 34 donated edges (30 org->person, 4 org->org) and the single ie edge; cross-checked against 12 profile fact lines (hdcc->mello w6, puyallup-tribe->mello w4, wea-pac->mello w4, nash-cascadia->mello w4, miles-sand-gravel->kelly-chambers w3, pierce-gop->chambers w9, etc).
rule_1_money_is_directional_safe.render: center is source -> '<verb> <neighbor>' ('donated to X', 'independent spending for X'); center is target -> '<verb> from X' ('donated by X', 'independent spending for X' [recipient-side]).

rule_2_role_family_needs_role_noun_not_v.why: Direction is mixed WITHIN these types, measured this pass. A raw-direction verb gloss produces wrong sentences for roughly half.

rels_with_mixed_or_inconsistent_directio.commissioner: 2 org->person (port-tacoma->mccarthy, port-tacoma->jt-wilcox) + 3 person->org (marzano, keller, ang -> port-tacoma)

rule_2_role_family_needs_role_noun_not_v.render: Do NOT say who acts when the rel is a role seat. Render the ROLE NOUN anchored to the organization, which reads correctly from either side: 'Commissioner at Port of Tacoma', 'Chair of Pierce Transit', 'CEO of MultiCare', 'Vice chair of Sound Transit', 'Board seat at TCC'. On the organization's page the same spoke reads 'Commissioner: John McCarthy' (role label + holder), never 'commissioner of John McCarthy'.

rule_3_special_cases.problem: Raw reading 'JBLM commands LTG McFarlane' is backwards. Provenance (profiles/ltg-mcfarlane.md edge line: 'ltg-mcfarlane, target=jblm, relationship=commands, weight=7') confirms the correct fact: LTG McFarlane commands JBLM.
rule_3_special_cases.render: On McFarlane page: 'Commanding general of JBLM'. On JBLM page: 'Commanded by LTG McFarlane'.

rule_3_special_cases.problem: Ownership chain on the graph is newspaper --owned_by--> mcclatchy --> chatham-am, so this third edge duplicates the chain with an inverted reading. Also note news-tribune's own page: 'news-tribune --owned_by--> mcclatchy' is correct; 'chatham-am --owned_by--> news-tribune' is not.
rule_3_special_cases.render: Skip the direct Chatham->Tribune edge when both chain edges are present in the same ego; or gloss the chain for readers: 'Owned by McClatchy (owned by Chatham Asset Management)'.

rule_3_special_cases.problem: 'member' gloss would claim Mello is a current member; fact line says 'Tacoma City Council Position 7, 2010-2019 (term-limited 2019)'. He is a FORMER member; the current tie is the separate county_partnership edge (tacoma-city-council -> ryan-mello w3).
org->org 'member' via the Perinatal Collaborative board (shared board seats), not membership. Reading 'MultiCare is a member of TPCHD' is wrong.

rule_3_special_cases.note: These are correct as-is; listed so the role-noun rule isn't over-applied. Walker chairs the transit commission; Ponepinto was appointed to the TCC board.

multi_edge_pairs._note: 19 node pairs carry 2+ edges. 12 are legitimately multi-relational - do NOT merge; render multiple labels (or keep the strongest + a count). 7 are same-rel mirrors - collapse before drawing (designer already claimed this fix; list here as the authoritative set).
multi_rel_keep: covers w2 + covered_by w2 (mirror pair of DIFFERENT rels - render once)
board_president w4 + board_chair w4 (near-duplicate; consider consolidating to one)
